title: chore(scripts): delete 11 root scripts nothing reaches; --self-test for check-node-version, check-release-notes and check-service-providers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RdxrKhQwWyCt2rysjANPQa)_
Part of #26091 — Wanted 1 and Wanted 3 only. Wanted 2 (one invocation spelling) stays on the card: it edits `.github/workflows/**` and the root alias map, held this round. #26091 remains open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

**Wanted 1 — 11 root scripts nothing reaches are deleted; 9 of the card's 20 stay because something does reach them.**

Census: for each of the card's 20 entry points, `git grep -l -F <file stem>` over the whole tree at `7111e14ac9` (every root, `ui/` included), with `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` as the positive control (32 files hit it, among them `package.json` and `lint.yml`). Every hit was read and classified.

Deleted — each hit was only a `docs/audits` reading, a release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` entry, a self-test fixture string or a comment:

| Script | What named it |
|---|---|
| `scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/audits/14423-c3-c4-keyed-mechanism-probe.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/audits/14423-databaseloader-cost-probe.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/audits/14423-filesystemloader-cost-probe.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/audits/14423-unbound-declarations-before-count.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/audits/14744-before-update-per-row-value-probe.mjs` | its `docs/audits` reading |
| `scripts/bench/permission-bench.mts` | 4 `CHANGELOG.md` entries only |
| `scripts/bench/runtime-publish-gate.bench.mts` | a path string in `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` fed to the pure predicate `isInRootTsProgram` (no disk read) |
| `scripts/measure-markdown-ts-blocks.mjs` | 20 `CHANGELOG.md` entries only |
| `scripts/measure-reserved-identity-name-census.mjs` | 1 `CHANGELOG.md` entry only |
| `scripts/pm/measurement-claim-triage.mjs` | one historical census row in a `dispatch-gates.mjs` docblock |

Every `docs/audits` "re-run" citation and comment that named a deleted script now names commit `7111e14ac9`, which holds it, with the `git worktree add --detach` line to re-run it from there (3 audit files and one `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` docblock line). `CHANGELOG.md` entries are release-owned and stay as they shipped. No `archive/` folder.

Kept — a real caller exists:

| Script | Caller |
|---|---|
| `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` | the ablation procedure in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `packages/qa/dogfood/README.md` tells agents to run it |
| `scripts/audits/14744-before-update-per-row-value-census.mjs` | a `COMPOUND_ANCHOR_LEDGER` row in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, which `check:pm-dispatch-gates` reconciles against the live tree in both directions (deleting it needs that row and the docblock counts moved — a ledger edit outside this card's file surface) |
| `scripts/codemod/view-to-viewitem.mjs` | ADR-0017 offers it to teams as the migration codemod; repointing that needs an ADR edit (Tier H) |
| `scripts/measure-return-propagating-durability-seams.mjs` | AGENTS.md (durability section) tells authors to read the population from it; `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` names it as the instrument |
| `scripts/measure-partial-retirement-annotation.mjs` | the slow tier of `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (`dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, the `seamCard` block) spawns the CLI against this path; deleting it reds 16 cases there — measured, see Acceptance notes |
| `scripts/measure-self-test-floor.mjs` | AGENTS.md "Writing a --self-test" names it as the probe |
| `scripts/pm/fleet-git-credential.sh` | `scripts/pm/with-fleet.sh` executes it and installs it as the git credential helper |
| `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` | the maintainer-ordered generator of the pinned fleet roster issue (landed three days before this census); the roster body's marker names it |
| `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` | `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` tells runners to run it after filing |

**Wanted 3 — `--self-test` for three of the five `check-*` scripts.** `scripts/check-node-version.mjs`, `scripts/check-release-notes.mjs` and `scripts/check-service-providers.mjs`:

- each rule moves into a pure function over its inputs (`auditSetupNodeSteps` + `lifecycleVerdict`, `findProblems`, `findProblems` + `parseTable`); `main()` keeps the tree read and prints the same bytes. Proof: old and new copies run side by side on a fixture tree, green path and every red path (missing page + unlisted page + unreachable section; provider typo + missing slot; one mismatched step; EOL, unknown and empty pins) — stdout, stderr and exit identical in all 9 runs;
- each self-test follows AGENTS.md "Writing a --self-test", copied from `check-agent-model-declared.mjs`: a literal row roster floored per label (10 / 11 / 14 rows), the roster size pinned, and a `selfTestReachedVerdict` handshake the dispatch refuses to run without. Negative controls are rows that must go RED (a missing page, a non-workspace provider, a mismatched or missing Node pin, an expression-resolved version, an EOL pin, a parser fed a source with no table). Problems now carry a `kind` and subject, so the cases assert what was found, never the message wording;
- the three root aliases CI already calls (`pnpm check:X` in `lint.yml`, and `check:release-notes` in `release.yml`) now run `--self-test` first — the house spelling — so `check:self-test-wired` sees each self-test run.

`scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `scripts/docs-audit/check-drift-comment.mjs` stay without one this round: both are run by direct `node` lines in workflows (`cut-rc.yml`, `release.yml`, `validate-deps.yml`; `docs-drift-check.yml`), so a self-test there is unwired — `check:self-test-wired` reds it, and its `SELF_TEST_RUN_OTHERWISE` ledger forbids a row for that — until a workflow step runs it. That wiring lands with Wanted 2, which edits those workflows anyway.

## Acceptance

- Card loop `for f in scripts/check-*.mjs; do grep -q -- --self-test $f || echo $f; done` → `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (one line, the deferred one above; was four).
- Census re-run on the head: the 11 deleted files have 0 callers. Remaining textual hits are the commit-pinned `docs/audits` citations, the `isInRootTsProgram` fixture string and the one historical `dispatch-gates.mjs` docblock row; `CHANGELOG.md` entries excluded.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 54 derived at `2e05d6c9a`, 54 run, every exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` → "54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Includes `check:self-test-wired`, `check:self-test-workflow-commands`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:node-version`, `check:release-notes`, `check:service-providers` and `check:type-check-debt` (root program still 26 errors, none above its record; the two deleted `.mts` files carried none).
- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` slow tier (CI runs it on push to main, not on this PR): `node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs --slow` at `2e05d6c9a` → "dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass", both tiers, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changed lines: +838 / −4,370 = 5,208, over the 3,000 human-merge threshold** (AGENTS.md, Multi-agent discipline §7 (c)) — almost all of it the deleted files. This PR lands by an authorized approval or a human merge, not by the queue on green alone.
- The first head deleted `scripts/measure-partial-retirement-annotation.mjs` too. The slow tier of `check:pm-dispatch-gates` — which CI runs on push to `main` and on the schedule, not on a PR — then failed 16 cases, all in its `seamCard` block (`the seam card still derives at all` first: the CLI answers exit 3, absent path). The script was restored at `2e05d6c9a` and listed as kept; the slow tier was re-run on that head (see Acceptance).
- Census correction: the card's list read `measure-markdown-ts-blocks.mjs`, `measure-reserved-identity-name-census.mjs` and `permission-bench.mts` as referenced nowhere; all three are named in shipped `CHANGELOG.md` entries (history, not callers). `fleet-roster.mjs` is named only by a comment, but it is a live maintainer tool, so it stays.
